svg.title: The contract a client actually depends on is bigger than the deliberate, documented contract alone
svg.desc: A larger outer rectangle labeled the actual contract clients depend on, per Hyrum's Law, contains a smaller inner rectangle labeled the deliberate contract: documented endpoints, fields, status codes, and error shapes. The margin between the inner and outer rectangles is labeled the accidental contract: field ordering, error message wording, and typical latency, behaviors never promised on purpose but still depended on once enough clients observe them.
svg.text: actual contract clients depend on (Hyrum's Law)

g.text: accidental contract: field ordering, error message
wording, typical latency, never promised, still depended on
